Welcome to our FAMILY! 
Since 1953, the Shuler Family has been caring for your fur babies! With 2 active locations in Mount Pleasant, SC, we care for your pets like they are our own. Veterinary Care Reimagined. 
To greater support the community, we are opening up our third location very soon: Safe Harbor Vet Clinic!
We are always accepting new clients, visit our website to make your next appointment!       https://animalhospitalsofthelowcountry.com/
